name: pamap2
paper_title: Introducing a New Benchmarked Dataset for Activity Monitoring
venue: 16th International Symposium on Wearable Computers (ISWC 2012), Newcastle, UK, June 18-22, 2012, pp. 108-109, IEEE
license: Dataset (UCI): CC BY 4.0. Canonical papers (ISWC 2012 IEEE / PETRA 2012 ACM): copyright IEEE/ACM, paywalled, no open-access copy. Saved PDF (first-author PhD thesis): open access via RPTU / TU Kaiserslautern institutional repository (KLUEDO).
notes: PAMAP2 = Physical Activity Monitoring dataset (v2). CANONICAL PAPER is the seeded 2-page ISWC 2012 abstract (Reiss & Stricker, doi:10.1109/ISWC.2012.13). A companion/longer paper by the same authors also describes the dataset: Reiss & Stricker, 'Creating and Benchmarking a New Dataset for Physical Activity Monitoring', PETRA 2012 (doi:10.1145/2413097.2413148). IMPORTANT: BOTH canonical short papers are paywalled (IEEE / ACM) with NO open-access copy available (Unpaywall reports both as closed; Semantic Scholar openAccessPdf status=CLOSED; ResearchGate copies exist but block automated download; DFKI author pages expose no PDF). Therefore the saved paper.pdf is NOT the ISWC abstract itself: it is first-author Attila Reiss's PhD thesis 'Personalized Mobile Physical Activity Monitoring for Everyday Life' (TU Kaiserslautern, 2014), open-access via the RPTU/KLUEDO institutional repository (docId 3681, 187 pages, PDF v1.4). This thesis is the definitive extended reference that defines and documents the PAMAP2 protocol in full detail (Chapters on data collection), so it is the most useful open artifact for cross-checking code against the dataset. pdf_url points to this thesis (the file actually downloaded). KEY DATASET FACTS for cross-check: 3 Colibri wireless IMUs sampled at 100 Hz, worn on the wrist of the dominant arm, on the chest, and on the dominant-side ankle; each IMU records temperature, 3D-acceleration at two scales (+/-16g and +/-6g), 3D-gyroscope, 3D-magnetometer, and orientation. Separate heart-rate monitor sampled at ~9 Hz. 9 subjects (mostly male, ages ~24-32). 18 activities total: 12 protocol activities (lying, sitting, standing, walking, running, cycling, Nordic walking, ascending stairs, descending stairs, vacuum cleaning, ironing, rope jumping) plus 6 optional activities (watching TV, computer work, car driving, folding laundry, house cleaning, playing soccer). Raw .dat files (subject101..109 plus Optional/) contain 54 columns: timestamp, activityID, heart_rate, then 17 columns per IMU (hand/chest/ankle). Missing values marked NaN; unlabeled data uses activityID 0. Dataset DOI: 10.24432/C5NW2H. Download ZIP ~656.3 MB: https://archive.ics.uci.edu/static/public/231/pamap2+physical+activity+monitoring.zip
